title: Alur Produksi Inti (Wizard -> Work Order -> Eksekusi -> Selesai)
description: Alur bisnis kritikal happy-path: PPIC membuat produksi via Production Wizard (Order + WO + Release + Bundle sekaligus), operator lantai mengisi progres per tahap via Input Harian Sederhana, dan WO/Order menyelesaikan diri (auto-complete) setelah PACKING memenuhi target.
happy_path_steps: Wizard Langkah 1 (Order): pilih pelanggan / centang Produksi Internal, tambah item (model+size+qty).
Wizard Langkah 2 (Preview): panggil preview-production (dry-run), tampilkan jumlah WO & bundle.
Wizard Langkah 3 (Confirm): panggil start-production -> Order confirmed + WO released + bundle tergenerate.
Work Order: verifikasi WO muncul berstatus released di /work-orders.
Eksekusi: Input Harian Sederhana per tahap SEWING -> FINISHING -> QC -> PACKING via execution/simple-input.
Selesai: PACKING memicu maybe_auto_complete_wo -> WO completed -> Order completed otomatis.
